description: Turn this customer win into a case study, a post and a newsletter without changing the number. Needs the exact result sentence with its qualifier and source label, source and date, your role, approval, your own view and a reader action. Returns a proof card, first drafts and a sentence check. Optional proof details expose gaps. Written approval is required for your own customer; without it, returns the card and questions only. Chat collects the facts; the results view shows them. No form.

approver.description: Who approved the uses, in writing.

date.description: Approval date as year, month and day.

uses.description: Every use explicitly covered by the written approval.

as_of_date.description: The date of this run as year, month and day. Supplied by chat so repeats stay identical.

buyer_view.description: Your own view in whole sentences. The tool will not invent it.

call_to_action.description: One action you want the reader to take.

challenge.description: The customer problem from the approved story.

customer_name.description: Customer label, including an approved anonymous description.

exact_sentence.description: Copy the result exactly, keeping its qualifier and source label inside this sentence.

measured_result.description: False for a story with no measured outcome. Never infer an improvement from exposure or scale counts.

denominator.description: Out of how many eligible cases.

fell_out.description: How excluded or abandoned cases were counted.

qualifier.description: The qualifier inside the locked sentence, or none stated.

review_by.description: Review date as year, month and day.

published_story.description: The already published story as plain text. Used as source without rebuilding it.

solution.description: What was done, from the approved story.

source_checked_date.description: The date you reopened the source, as year, month and day. This is not the publication date.

source_date.description: Publication or evidence date as year, month and day, or not stated. Keep it separate from the measurement period.

source_kind.description: Who stands behind the result. A company report is not independent evidence.

source_label.description: The source label already inside the exact sentence, for example company-reported.

source_url.description: Public source or approved evidence link, using https.

name: customer_result_to_content
title: Turn this customer result into content
